summary: Both reported bugs are FIXED and verified. Find Schools page now displays correctly with match scores for users who completed onboarding. ProgressRail stage keys match between backend and frontend.

BUG_FIX_1_suggested_schools.description: GET /api/suggested-schools crashed because division was stored as list but code called .upper() on it
BUG_FIX_1_suggested_schools.fix: Now handles both list and string for division field at lines 250-253 in athlete_profile.py
BUG_FIX_1_suggested_schools.verification: Returns 12 suggestions with match_score=86% for douglas@yeslms.com

BUG_FIX_2_progress_rail_stages.description: ProgressRail stage keys mismatched between backend and frontend
BUG_FIX_2_progress_rail_stages.fix: Backend compute_journey_rail now uses keys: added, outreach, in_conversation, campus_visit, offer, committed (NOT outreach_sent, coach_replied)
BUG_FIX_2_progress_rail_stages.verification: journey_rail.stages returns correct keys, DB migration completed (0 programs with old keys)

find_schools_page.top_match_banner: Displayed - Abilene Christian University with 86% match score
find_schools_page.match_reasons: Displayed - Division Match, Preferred Region, Academics, Scholarship
find_schools_page.smart_filter_chips: All Schools 1053, Dream Schools (D1) 347, Strong Match (80%+) 12

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Find Schools page displays correctly with match scores)

test_credentials.profile: Premium plan user with completed questionnaire (division=['D1', 'D2'], regions=['Southeast'])

seed_data_creation: Test programs for University of Georgia, University of Florida, and Clemson University were created during testing and cleaned up after
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs that caused Find Schools to show no matches after onboarding are fixed: (1) suggested-schools endpoint now handles division as list, (2) ProgressRail stage keys are updated in both backend compute_journey_rail and DB migration. The knowledge base has 1053 schools and match scores display correctly for users with completed profiles.

rca_of_the_issue.bug_1_root_cause: In athlete_profile.py line ~253, the code was calling .upper() directly on the division field without checking if it was a list. The onboarding questionnaire stores division as a list (e.g., ['D1', 'D2']) but the suggested-schools endpoint assumed it was a string.
rca_of_the_issue.bug_1_fix: Added check: if isinstance(pref_divisions, str): pref_divisions = [pref_divisions] if pref_divisions else []
rca_of_the_issue.bug_2_root_cause: Backend compute_journey_rail in programs.py used stage keys 'outreach_sent' and 'coach_replied' but frontend ProgressRail.js expected 'outreach' and 'in_conversation'
rca_of_the_issue.bug_2_fix: Updated backend stage keys to match frontend, added LEGACY_MAP to handle existing DB values, ran DB migration to rename journey_stage values
